content: Signing fully fixed. Root cause: crosslink trust approve only registers agent keys in allowed_signers, not the driver's human key. Manually appended driver-key.pub to .hub-cache/trust/allowed_signers; committed on hub branch (2d65522, sig=G). signing_enforcement restored to enforced; sync reports all 5 recent commits signed. Upstream bug to file against crosslink: trust approve / init should add the driver key to allowed_signers automatically. Hub branch still needs git push from user.
